title: 150. Single Number

examples.explanation: Every number in [2, 2, 1] appears twice except 1, so 1 is the single number.
Every number in [4, 1, 2, 1, 2] appears twice except 4, so 4 is the single number.
The only number in [1] is 1, which appears once, so 1 is the single number.

hints: XOR is associative and commutative, and a value XOR itself is zero.
XOR every array element together; each pair cancels and the unpaired value remains.
